en: Recommended power (a stage's reference power for the power gate)
note: Team power ÷ recommended power picks the damage bracket. Community shorthand: 권투, 권투력.

en: Power cut: the team power where a bracket starts (e.g. '328-30 35% 컷 4G')
The 35% bracket: pushing at 40–59% of recommended power, keeping 35% of damage
The 15% bracket: 20–39% of recommended power, keeping 15% of damage
Exactly at a bracket's power cut
Raw power (real power, as opposed to padded or Rift-inflated power)
Main stage (chapter-stage, e.g. 243-30)
Idle/auto deck: a stage deck that clears without manual play
Manual control (steering cookies by hand in a stage fight)
Clear deck: the lineup a clear was made with
Ordinary mobs; a mob (non-boss) stage
Launch (airborne) attack; a 'launch boss' throws the team into the air
Accuracy + focus (명중 + 집중) together
Parking: staying on the highest cleared stage for its idle rewards
Dimensional Rift (차원의 이면), the seasonal boss-only mode after 328-30
note: Record 003's short forms; the full name's entry comes from the earlier records.

en: Dimensional Energy: the Rift-only level that fills per minute in the Rift and raises stats there
Dimensional Energy level (차원의 힘), as posters shorten it
Rift power: the team power the Rift shows in its header, 차원의 힘 included, which sets a Rift level's bracket
Twisting: forcing a clear one bracket lower than comfortable, usually at 15%
The three Rowdy Trucks of a Rift truck level
Dimension Fragment: the Rift shop's currency
GingerCraven (비겁한 쿠키), the ruined-city and snowfield -30 boss
Rowdy Biker (the ruined city's -10, three of them)
Rowdy Truck (the ruined city's -20)
Redberry Assassin (the plaza's -10 pack)
Choco Werehound Princess (the plaza's -20, a launch boss)
Tainted Ent (the mushroom zone's -20 and -30, a launch boss)
Cream Eagle (the desert's -10)
Ginkgoblin Stormer (the desert's -20 and -30)
King Choco Drop (the grassland's -10, a launch boss; not the pet)
Jelly Worm (the grassland's -20)
Cake Hound Pack (grassland mob stages; Rift level 6)
Mangosteen Water Bomber (the beach's -10 and -20)
Poison Shroomer (the mushroom zone's -10, a pack of ten)
Magma Waffle Lizard (the lava zone's -10 to -15 packs)
Magma Sugar Waffle Lizard (the lava zone's -20 and -30)
Ice Cone Lancer (snowfield packs, e.g. -10)
Ice Candy Golem (the snowfield's -20)
